basis: Recovered platform menu and page branches are driven by supplierId and explicit permission strings. OPERATOR and FINANCE reuse the existing platform components; no separate role-name UI fork is needed.

source.settlementTabs: usage.read => daily+inputs; settlement.read => statements; payment.read => payments; exchange_rate.read => rates
source.defaultRoleAllocation: Local implementation policy v2 in backend/RolePolicy.java; OPERATOR33 permissions includes resource.config.read/write/test; FINANCE28.

dialogs: quote inline editor or detail/review drawer

execution.credentials: Read OPERATOR_USERNAME/PASSWORD and FINANCE_USERNAME/PASSWORD from backend/.env; do not print password values.
checks: actual permission-aware menu vs readable catalog
all reachable routes render without runtime error
main page GET responses have correct shapes
forbidden writes return 403 before data validation
allowed creation/review dialogs open and close without submitting
limitations: No online OPERATOR/FINANCE account was supplied; no pixel fidelity score is calculated.
Local DOM and runtime checks are reported separately from the existing 24 paired screenshot score.
Forbidden writes use empty/invalid bodies only after static proof of a permission gate, so unexpected acceptance cannot create valid business records.
